summary: Frontend interview practice handoff. Event loop/async scheduling cluster is Senior-ready: candidate correctly reasoned about Promise chaining, async/await suspension, task vs microtask checkpoints, microtask starvation, time slicing, responsiveness vs throughput, and Web Worker trade-offs. React cluster is in progress: candidate correctly explained React.memo with object/function reference changes, avoided unnecessary useMemo/useCallback, chose module-scope constants for static data, preferred simpler prop APIs when appropriate, and explained stale closures from missing dependencies with production bug examples. Next question to ask in the new chat: React State/Batching with three calls to setCount(count + 1); ask for the final count and explanation via render snapshot → batching → update queue → why it is not +3.
